## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the business problem, the change, and the observable result.

## Evidence

Link the exact commit, input/truth-set version, commands, test results, and relevant
dbt artifacts. Name the environment actually executed. Keep PostgreSQL and
Snowflake qualification separate.

## Compatibility and recovery

Explain changes to contracts, source identities, golden IDs, consumer events and
history. Include a migration or compensating-decision path if state changes.

## Remaining limits

List unexecuted integrations, unresolved defects, and required maintainer decisions.
Describe automated or assistant review accurately; do not claim independent approval.
